v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: O magnum pietátis opus: * mors mórtua tunc est, in ligno quando mórtua Vita fuit.
text.en: O what a work of love was that * when Life and death died together upon the Tree.

text.la: Salva nos, * Christe Salvátor, per virtútem Crucis: qui salvásti Petrum in mari, miserére nobis.
text.en: Save us, * O Christ the Saviour, save us through the might of thy Cross Thou Who didst save Peter when he was ready to sink in the sea, have mercy upon us.

text.la: Ecce Crucem Dómini, * fúgite, partes advérsæ, vicit leo de tribu Iuda, radix David, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, the Cross of the Lord! * fly, ye ranks of the adversary! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed. Alleluia.

text.la: Nos autem gloriári * opórtet in Cruce Dómini nostri Iesu Christi.
text.en: But us it behoveth to glory * in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.la: Per signum Crucis * de inimícis nostris líbera nos, Deus noster.
text.en: By thy Cross' holy sign, * Jesus, guard this soul of mine from my ghostly enemy.

text.la: Fratres: Hoc enim sentíte in vobis, quod et in Christo Iesu: qui, cum in forma Dei esset, non rapínam arbitrátus est esse se æquálem Deo: sed semetípsum exinanívit, formam servi accípiens, in similitúdinem hóminum factus, et hábitu invéntus ut homo.
text.en: For let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus: Who being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men, and in habit found as a man.

v.la: Hoc signum Crucis erit in cælo.
v.en: This sign of the Cross shall be in heaven.

r.en: When the Lord cometh to judgment.

text.la: O Crux benedícta, * quæ sola fuísti digna portáre Regem cælórum et Dóminum, allelúia.
text.en: O blessed art thou, O Cross * thou which wast counted the only tree worthy to bear the Lord and King of heaven. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui nos hodiérna die Exaltatiónis sanctæ Crucis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, cuius mystérium in terra cognóvimus, eius redemptiónis prǽmia in cælo mereámur.
text.en: O God, Who dost this day gladden us by the yearly Feast of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross, grant, we beseech thee, that even as we have understood the mystery thereof upon earth, so we may worthily enjoy in heaven the fruits of the redemption which was paid thereon.
